newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's agriculture minister Lakos sacked.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's agriculture minister Lakos sacked.

text.p: Hungarian Prime Minister Gyula Horn has dismissed Agriculture Minister Laszlo Lakos from his post as of December 15, Horn's office said on Wednesday.

"A leadership change at the ministry has become necessary in light of the need for a national agricultural programme that would meet European Union requirements," a statement from the prime minister's office said.
Horn will announce his proposal for a new agriculture minister in the next days, the statement said.
Horn accepted Welfare Minister Gyorgy Szabo's resignation on Monday. Szabo quit over lack of funding for his ministry.
Lakos is the 10th minister to depart from Horn's coalition government of Socialists and Free Democrats since it was formed in May 1994. All but one have been appointees of Horn's Socialist Party.
